NAME: DSU verification plan
details: Source: GARUDA-DSU-SPEC-001, section 2 (requirements), section 10 (assertions) and section 11 (verification plan), written with the specification. Moved into vPlanner form on 2026-10-04; section 4 holds what the 2026-10-04 flow run added.

NAME: Requirements
details: From section 2 of the specification; planned tests from section 11.

NAME: R-1 Three independent 16 16 multiply-accumulate units with 48-bit ...
details: Three independent 16×16 multiply-accumulate units with 48-bit accumulators.
implementation_note: Source: System

NAME: t_dsu_mac
details: Oracle: each accumulator accumulates correctly Coverage goal: all 3
implementation_note: Status in the specification: passing. Bench: tb/dsu/tb_dsu_top.sv: directed and random vectors from tools/gen/DSU_gen.py on all three accumulators - 445 vectors compared with the model (tools/golden/DSU_Golden.py), 0 mismatches, in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-2 Decoded in EX from Custom-0 not a bus peripheral.
details: Decoded in EX from Custom-0; not a bus peripheral.
implementation_note: Source: ADR, latency

NAME: t_dsu_decode
details: Oracle: all 9 instructions decode and execute Coverage goal: 9/9
implementation_note: Status in the specification: passing. Bench: tb/dsu/tb_dsu_top.sv: the directed set runs every instruction once (tools/gen/DSU_gen.py, directed_tests) - 445 vectors compared with the model (tools/golden/DSU_Golden.py), 0 mismatches, in the 2026-10-04 regression. Through the pipeline: sw/tests/t_dsu.S, TOHOST=1 PASSED.

NAME: R-3 A stated normative fixed-point format.
details: A stated, normative fixed-point format.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0017

NAME: t_dsu_qformat
details: Oracle: Q1.15 × Q1.15 → Q2.30 → Q18.30 against a Python golden model Coverage goal: ≥10⁴ random operand pairs
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: PARTLY IMPLEMENTED - tb/dsu/tb_dsu_top.sv compares random operand pairs with the Python model, but the regression stimulus is 445 vectors in total, not the 10 000 pairs the plan states (the generator takes --count).

NAME: t_dsu_qformat_edge
details: Oracle: ±1.0−ε, ±smallest, zero, and all sign combinations Coverage goal: all 9 combinations
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/dsu/tb_dsu_top.sv: the directed set holds the extreme products (0x7FFF, 0x8000, min x min, sign-extended loads) - 445 vectors compared with the model (tools/golden/DSU_Golden.py), 0 mismatches, in the 2026-10-04 regression. The nine sign combinations are not counted separately.

NAME: R-4 Saturating accumulation with a sticky overflow flag per ...
details: Saturating accumulation with a sticky overflow flag per accumulator.
implementation_note: Source: Numerical safety

NAME: t_dsu_saturate
details: Oracle: positive and negative saturation; no wrap Coverage goal: both directions
implementation_note: Status in the specification: extend. Bench: tb/dsu/tb_dsu_top.sv: directed vectors push the accumulator over the 49th bit and clamp, and check that the boundary value does not clamp - 445 vectors compared with the model (tools/golden/DSU_Golden.py), 0 mismatches, in the 2026-10-04 regression. The generator also has a clamp-walk mode; it is not part of the regression stimulus.

NAME: t_dsu_ovf_sticky
details: Oracle: sticky; set beats a same-cycle clear
implementation_note: Status in the specification: extend. Bench: tb/dsu/tb_dsu_top.sv: directed vectors for the sticky flag clear and for an overflow landing on its own clear (erratum DSU-8) - 445 vectors compared with the model (tools/golden/DSU_Golden.py), 0 mismatches, in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-5 Same-accumulator RAW hazards interlocked in hardware.
details: Same-accumulator RAW hazards interlocked in hardware.
implementation_note: Source: Correctness

NAME: t_dsu_interlock
details: Oracle: fires on same-acc, not on cross-acc Coverage goal: 9 acc pairs
implementation_note: Status in the specification: passing. Bench: PARTLY IMPLEMENTED - sw/tests/t_dsu.S (back-to-back readbacks on one accumulator) and sw/tests/t_dsu_b2b.S (new: same-accumulator and cross-accumulator pairs back to back), both TOHOST=1 PASSED. The nine accumulator pairs are not all run.

NAME: t_dsu_flush
details: Oracle: a flushed DSU op does not accumulate Coverage goal: flush at each pipeline position
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: PARTLY IMPLEMENTED - sw/tests/t_hold_flush_matrix.S bits 8, 9, 10, 11 and 15 (a MAC behind a store, an illegal Custom-0 behind a MAC, a trap straight behind a MAC, a jump while a readback is held, a MAC behind a WFI), TOHOST=1 PASSED. A flush at each pipeline position is not swept; the unit bench never asserts flush.

NAME: R-6 Accumulators readable by the debugger without stopping the core.
details: Accumulators readable by the debugger without stopping the core.
implementation_note: Source: Bring-up

NAME: t_dsu_taps
details: Oracle: taps readable while accumulating
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/debug/tb_debug.sv, checks [N-6.7] the taps are read live while the accumulator runs, [N-6.8] coherent 48-bit snapshot on all three accumulators, dsuovf - 6 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-7 acc_sel = 2 b11 shall be illegal everywhere.
details: acc_sel = 2'b11 shall be illegal everywhere.
implementation_note: Source: ADR

NAME: t_dsu_accsel3
details: Oracle: illegal exception, no accumulator change Coverage goal: all instructions carrying the field
implementation_note: Status in the specification: extend. Bench: tb/dsu/tb_dsu_top.sv: the directed set ends with the illegal encodings, which must be rejected with the state untouched - 445 vectors compared with the model (tools/golden/DSU_Golden.py), 0 mismatches, in the 2026-10-04 regression. Not every instruction carrying the field is listed.

NAME: Planned tests not tied to one requirement
t_dsu_apf
details: Oracle: full 10-neighbour APF loop vs. a float reference, error bound stated
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: NOT IMPLEMENTED - no APF loop and no float reference in sw/ or tools/.

NAME: t_dsu_ekf_scope
details: Oracle: the prediction and residual paths match a float reference within the stated bound; covariance is not attempted
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: NOT IMPLEMENTED - no EKF path test and no float reference in sw/ or tools/.

NAME: t_dsu_gate
details: Oracle: accumulators retain values across gated cycles
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: PARTLY IMPLEMENTED - only sw/tests/t_hold_flush_matrix.S bit 15 (a MAC parked behind a WFI accumulates exactly once across the sleep), TOHOST=1 PASSED; there is no test that reads all accumulators before and after gated cycles.

NAME: Assertions
details: From section 10 of the specification.

NAME: a_no_realign
details: product/accumulator alignment: accumulate is a plain add, no shift (N-6.3)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Behaviour compared with the model on every vector in tb/dsu/tb_dsu_top.sv.

NAME: a_saturate_pos
details: saturation, not wrap (N-6.8)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Behaviour compared with the model in tb/dsu/tb_dsu_top.sv (directed saturation vectors).

NAME: a_saturate_neg
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Behaviour compared with the model in tb/dsu/tb_dsu_top.sv (directed saturation vectors).

NAME: a_never_wraps
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Behaviour compared with the model in tb/dsu/tb_dsu_top.sv.

NAME: a_ovf_sticky
details: overflow is sticky and set-beats-clear (N-6.9)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Behaviour compared with the model in tb/dsu/tb_dsu_top.sv (sticky flag clear vectors).

NAME: a_ovf_set_beats_clear
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Behaviour compared with the model in tb/dsu/tb_dsu_top.sv (erratum DSU-8 vector).

NAME: a_ovf_from_49
details: overflow detection uses the full 49-bit intermediate (OPEN-9)

NAME: a_accsel3_illegal
details: acc_sel = 11 is always illegal (R-7, N-7.4)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Behaviour compared with the model in tb/dsu/tb_dsu_top.sv (illegal encodings).

NAME: a_accsel3_no_effect
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Behaviour compared with the model in tb/dsu/tb_dsu_top.sv (illegal encodings, state untouched).

NAME: a_interlock_per_acc
details: interlock is per accumulator (N-7.8)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked by sw/tests/t_dsu_b2b.S (cross-accumulator pairs; found DSU-11).

NAME: a_interlock_fires
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked by sw/tests/t_dsu.S and t_dsu_b2b.S (found DSU-12).

NAME: a_flush_no_accumulate
details: a flushed DSU instruction must not accumulate (N-7.9)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked by sw/tests/t_hold_flush_matrix.S bits 9 and 10.

NAME: a_macsat
details: MACSAT saturates correctly to Q1.15
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Behaviour compared with the model in tb/dsu/tb_dsu_top.sv; MACSAT behind a MAC in sw/tests/t_dsu_b2b.S.

NAME: a_taps_live
details: taps are always live, never gated (R-6)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/debug/tb_debug.sv ([N-6.7]).

NAME: a_gate_retains
details: accumulators retain value while clock-gated (N-7.22)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED - named in the specification only; see t_dsu_gate.

NAME: a_single_cycle
details: single-cycle throughput except on interlock (N-7.1)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED - named in the specification only.

NAME: Added in the 2026-10-04 run
details: Checks added and defects found when the flow was run in order on 2026-10-04 (Docs/BUGS.md section 1h). All three were invisible to the unit bench, which drives one instruction at a time and never flushes.

NAME: DSU-13 trap flush discarded a committed accumulate
details: The pending product belongs to a MAC that has already left EX, but flush cleared it: a MAC followed by an instruction that trapped lost its product silently.
implementation_note: FIXED in rtl/dsu/mac_unit.v. t_hold_flush_matrix bits 9, 10; PASS.

NAME: DSU-11 one accumulator corrupted by an instruction for another
details: load and clear are cluster-wide decodes and the accumulator mux used them without checking the instruction addressed this unit: MAC acc0; MACCLEAR acc1 set acc0 to 0.
implementation_note: FIXED in rtl/dsu/mac_unit.v. sw/tests/t_dsu_b2b.S; PASS.

NAME: DSU-12 MACSAT ran in the held cycle
details: MACSAT behind a MAC on the same accumulator is held one cycle by the interlock but saturated the stale value anyway; the product was lost and the overflow flag raised for a value that never existed.
implementation_note: FIXED in rtl/dsu/dsu_top.v. sw/tests/t_dsu_b2b.S bit 2; PASS.

NAME: Tests added
details: sw/tests/t_dsu_b2b.S (back-to-back DSU instructions through the pipeline).
